units.source_text: 正是‘未曾相识难言恋’了。”

en.t: It was just as the saying goes: it is hard to speak of love before one has even met.

units.source_text: 这回写在一张极柔软的薄纸上，书法实甚优美。

en.t: This time the reply was written on a sheet of very soft, thin paper, and the handwriting was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 明石姬看了，心念自己是个少女，

en.t: When Lady Akashi saw it, she thought to herself that she was still a young girl,

units.source_text: 看了这优美的情书若不动心，未免太畏缩了。

en.t: and that if such a beautiful love letter did not move her heart, she would be far too timid.

units.source_text: 源氏公子的俊俏是可爱的，但身份相差太远，

en.t: Lord Genji's handsome charm was lovable, but the difference in their rank was far too great,
so even if her heart was moved, it would be in vain.

units.source_text: 如今竟蒙青眼，特地寄书，

en.t: Now, however, he had unexpectedly shown her favor and specially sent her a letter,
and when she thought of it, tears could not help filling her eyes.
Again she refused to write a reply.

units.source_text: 经老父多方劝勉，方始援笔作复。

en.t: Only after her old father urged and encouraged her in every way did she finally take up the brush and compose an answer.

units.source_text: 写在一张浓香薰透的紫色纸上，

en.t: She wrote it on a sheet of purple paper thoroughly scented with a rich fragrance,

units.source_text: 墨色忽浓忽淡，似乎故意做作。

en.t: and the ink was dark in places and pale in others, as though deliberately affected.
